versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11001 If CallTrustedFunction calls the trusted function, that function shall continue to run on the same interrupt/task priority and be allowed to call system services defined for inside trusted functions.

If CallTrustedFunction calls the trusted function from a Cat- egory 2 ISR context, that function shall continue to run on the same interrupt priority and be allowed to call all system services defined for Category 2 ISR .
